items.title: Amazon Corretto 27正式推出，支援TLS 1.3的後量子混合金鑰交換
items.summary: 繼9月15日Oracle發布Java 27（Oracle JDK 27），內建JEP 527這項關於TLS 1.3後量子混合金鑰交換的JDK增強提案，進一步提升後量子密碼學（PQC）能力，由AWS提供的免費OpenJDK開發環境Amazon Corretto

items.title: JadePuffer借助AI代理攻擊Azure，微軟揭露兩起雲端資料破壞事件
items.summary: 資安業者Sysdig今年7月揭露勒索攻擊活動JadePuffer，指出其利用AI代理自動執行偵察、竊取憑證、橫向移動及資料加密等攻擊流程，後續更將攻擊範圍擴大至AI資產、訓練資料集與向量資料庫。

items.title: OpenAI公布協同平臺Space及類似Office的生產力套件
items.summary: OpenAI週二開發者大會DevDay上公布能讓企業員工在ChatGPT內協同作業的工具Space，以及類似Office的生產力套件。

items.title: Mozilla發布Firefox 157改版，修補近80個弱點
items.summary: Mozilla於9月29日正式推出Firefox 157改版，導入全新設計的圖形介面，並提供內建的深色佈景主題與精簡介面模式，然而，這次他們也修補了76個資安漏洞，其中有38個為高風險等級。

items.title: 川普與OpenAI、Google等科技巨頭簽署AI安全協議，引進外部獨立稽核
items.summary: 美國總統川普（Donald Trump）周二（9/29）與Google、OpenAI、Meta、Anthropic、xAI及Nvidia等6家AI與科技巨頭簽署《白宮超級智慧協議》（White House Accord on Super Intelligence），要求參與企業建立四層AI安全管控與稽核機制，包括引進獨立外部稽核。這項協議目前屬企業自願承諾，不具法律強制力，川普形容它具有「道德上的約束力」。

items.title: 商周集團透露網站遭受攻擊事故復原後續進度：中秋節前已將兩個網站重新上線
items.summary: 9月9日商周集團公告旗下網站遭到攻擊，導致網站與系統服務中斷，一週後該集團主網站的基礎服務恢復，上週末商周再度公布新的進展：他們在9月24日宣布，良醫健康網與alive這兩個網站，在經過外部資安專案的深度檢測與測試下，已確認網站的環境安全並正式重新啟用。

items.title: fix(agents): sessions_yield rejects watched child follow-ups (#161130)
items.summary: fix(agents): sessions_yield rejects watched child follow-ups (#161130) Create completion claims for watched announce-mode sessions_send follow-ups before returning, so sessions_yield can wait for the child result. Preserve each accepted completion through requester retirement and deliver distinct follow-up results once through normal settlement. Keep completion ownership, durable publication, and settlement in the subagent registry. Bind steering to the execution that accepted the input, retain exact requester custody, and reject stale authority before queue admission. Separate cohort ownership from actual announcement-delivery takeover so pending handoffs retain their settlement evidence. No schema, configuration, SDK, queue-durability, or permission contract changes. Validation: 204 lifecycle tests, 2,656 enumerated cases, eight real-Gateway authority tests, live exactly-once completion proof, and independent Codex review with zero actionable findings. The conflict-free main refresh preserves the PR patch; its activity-summary suite passes 23/23, core typecheck passes, and diff checks pass. Exact-head CI 36703463208 and security publisher 36704901328 passed on 4899d8fd9c13. ClawSweeper revision 13/run 36703616603 completed on that head with no code or security findings.

items.summary: test(gateway): drain the chat run instead of a 1s agent.wait in the verboseLevel case (#161763) * test(gateway): drain the chat run in the verboseLevel case instead of a 1s wait The case asserted agent.wait returned a terminal "ok" for a run it had just started with chat.send, using a timeoutMs: 1_000 budget. Under shard load the run can outlast that second, agent.wait then reports "timeout" and the assertion fails (compact-large-40, reproducible on main as well as on an unrelated PR head). Use the file's existing waitForAgentRunDrained helper, which waits for the request execution to finish and then reads the same terminal status without a wall-clock budget. * test(gateway): retain write-scoped terminal wait coverage --------- Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
